lemma finite_bridge_sums_of_firstLengthWeight
    (hL : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → Summable (firstLengthWeight (h := h))) : FiniteBridgeSums := by
  intro h hh
  have hw : Summable (weight (h := h)) := summable_weight_of_summable_firstLengthWeight (hL h hh)
  have hc : Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p.val) :=
    (hL h hh).subtype (fun p : BridgePath h => InLogCorridor p)
  exact ⟨hw, hL h hh, (hL h hh).div_const (bridgeMass h),
    hw.subtype (fun p : BridgePath h => InLogCorridor p), hc, hc.div_const (confinedMass h)⟩

/-- Frozen sub-contract for the hard part: for every `h ≥ 1`, the number of length-`n`
bridge paths grows geometrically with a base strictly below `1 / criticalActivity`.
Note `β` may depend on `h`; no uniform `β` can work (see RESEARCH.md). -/
def StripCountBound : Prop :=
  ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∃ C β : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ β * criticalActivity < 1 ∧
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, p.vertices.length = n) → (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (C : ℝ) * β ^ n

lemma finite_bridge_sums_of_stripCountBound (H : StripCountBound) : FiniteBridgeSums := by
  refine finite_bridge_sums_of_firstLengthWeight fun h hh => ?_
  obtain ⟨C, β, hC, hβ, hlt, hcount⟩ := H h hh
  exact summable_firstLengthWeight_of_count_bound hC hβ hlt hcount

def examplePath2 : BridgePath 2 where
  vertices := [.up 0 0, .down 0 0, .up 0 1, .down 0 1]
  distinct := by decide
  connected := by
    refine List.IsChain.cons_cons ?_ (List.IsChain.cons_cons ?_ (List.IsChain.cons_cons ?_ (List.IsChain.singleton _)))
    · simp [adjacent]
    · simp [adjacent]
    · simp [adjacent]
  source := rfl
  terminal := ⟨0, rfl⟩
  inStrip := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

lemma cos_pi_div_eight_pos : 0 < Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) := by
  apply Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
  constructor <;> nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]

lemma criticalActivity_mul_mu : criticalActivity * (2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8)) = 1 := by
  have hc := cos_pi_div_eight_pos
  have hne : Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
  unfold criticalActivity
  field_simp

lemma inv_mul_cancel' : criticalActivity = (2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8))⁻¹ := rfl

lemma two_mul_criticalActivity_gt_one : 1 < 2 * criticalActivity := by
  have hc := cos_pi_div_eight_pos
  have hm := criticalActivity_mul_mu
  have hmu : 0 < 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) := by linarith
  rw [inv_mul_cancel'] at hm
  -- criticalActivity = 1/(2c); 2 * criticalActivity = 2/(2c) = 1/c > 1 since c < 1
  have hclt : Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) < 1 := by
    have h := Real.cos_pi_div_eight
    have hs : Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) < 2 := by
      have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := by
        calc Real.sqrt 2 < Real.sqrt 4 := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
          _ = 2 := by norm_num
      calc Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) < Real.sqrt 4 :=
            Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by positivity) (by linarith)
        _ = 2 := by norm_num
    rw [h]; linarith
  rw [inv_mul_cancel']
  have hne : Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
  have : (2 : ℝ) * (2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8))⁻¹ = (Real.cos (Real.pi / 8))⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  rw [this]
  exact (one_lt_inv_iff₀).mpr ⟨hc, hclt⟩

lemma criticalActivity_sq : criticalActivity ^ 2 = (2 + Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ := by
  have hcos : Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) = Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) / 2 := Real.cos_pi_div_eight
  have hpos : 0 < 2 + Real.sqrt 2 := by
    have := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2; linarith
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = 2 + Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hpos)
  unfold criticalActivity
  rw [hcos]
  have hsimp : 2 * (Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) / 2) = Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) := by ring
  rw [hsimp, inv_pow, hsq]


/-! ### Growth-rate form of the missing counting input and its conversion -/

/-- **Natural form of the missing combinatorial input.**  The number of length-`n` bridge
paths in the width-`h` strip grows geometrically with a base strictly below the honeycomb
connective constant `2 cos (π/8) = √(2+√2)`.  Both `C` and `β` may depend on `h`
(no uniform `β` can work, since the strip connective constants increase to `μ_hex`). -/
def StripGrowthBelowMu : Prop :=
  ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∃ C β : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧
    β < 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) ∧
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, p.vertices.length = n) → (s.card : ℝ) ≤ C * β ^ n

lemma stripCountBound_of_stripGrowthBelowMu (H : StripGrowthBelowMu) : StripCountBound := by
  intro h hh
  obtain ⟨C, β, hC, hβ, hlt, hcount⟩ := H h hh
  refine ⟨C, β, hC, hβ, ?_, hcount⟩
  calc β * criticalActivity
      < (2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8)) * criticalActivity :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlt criticalActivity_pos
    _ = 1 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact criticalActivity_mul_mu

theorem finite_bridge_sums_of_stripGrowthBelowMu (H : StripGrowthBelowMu) :
    FiniteBridgeSums :=
  finite_bridge_sums_of_stripCountBound (stripCountBound_of_stripGrowthBelowMu H)



/-! ### Direct-application corollaries -/

/-- If the width-`h` strip counting base is below `μ_hex = 2cos(π/8)` together with
`StripCountBound`'s shape, `firstLengthWeight` is summable. -/
lemma summable_firstLengthWeight_of_growth_below_mu {h : ℕ} {C β : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hlt : β < 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8))
    (hcount : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, p.vertices.length = n) → (s.card : ℝ) ≤ C * β ^ n) :
    Summable (firstLengthWeight (h := h)) := by
  refine summable_firstLengthWeight_of_count_bound hC hβ ?_ hcount
  calc β * criticalActivity
      < (2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8)) * criticalActivity :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlt criticalActivity_pos
    _ = 1 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact criticalActivity_mul_mu


open scoped BigOperators

/-- Position of a vertex along the infinite direction of the strip.  In the brick-wall picture
the strip has one vertex per layer in each "column" `hexX = c`. -/
def hexX : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- `(hexX, layer)` is injective, so the frozen vertex type *is* the brick-wall strip. -/
lemma eq_of_hexX_layer {v w : Vertex} (hX : hexX v = hexX w) (hj : layer v = layer w) :
    v = w := by
  cases v with
  | up i j =>
    cases w with
    | up i' j' =>
      simp only [hexX, layer] at hX hj
      subst hj
      have : i = i' := by omega
      subst this; rfl
    | down i' j' =>
      simp only [hexX, layer] at hX hj
      omega
  | down i j =>
    cases w with
    | up i' j' =>
      simp only [hexX, layer] at hX hj
      omega
    | down i' j' =>
      simp only [hexX, layer] at hX hj
      subst hj
      have : i = i' := by omega
      subst this; rfl

/-- A step between two vertices of the *same* layer moves `hexX` by exactly `±1`. -/
lemma hexX_step {a b : Vertex} (hl : layer a = layer b) (hab : adjacent a b) :
    hexX b = hexX a + 1 ∨ hexX b = hexX a - 1 := by
  cases a with
  | up i j => cases b with
    | up _ _ => simp [adjacent] at hab
    | down k l =>
      simp only [adjacent] at hab
      have hl' : j = l := hl
      simp only [hexX]
      rcases hab with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;> omega
  | down k l => cases b with
    | down _ _ => simp [adjacent] at hab
    | up i j =>
      simp only [adjacent] at hab
      have hl' : l = j := hl
      simp only [hexX]
      rcases hab with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;> omega

lemma hexX_up_zero : hexX (.up 0 0) = 0 := rfl

lemma head?_eq_getElem?_zero {α : Type*} (l : List α) : l.head? = l[0]? := by
  cases l <;> rfl

lemma ne_nil_of_vertices_nonempty {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : p.vertices ≠ [] := by
  intro hnil
  have hsrc := p.source
  rw [hnil] at hsrc
  simp at hsrc

open scoped BigOperators

/-- **The frozen adjacency is exactly the brick-wall (hexagonal) strip.**  In the coordinates
`(hexX, layer)` every edge is either *horizontal* (same layer, `hexX` moves by `±1`) or
*vertical* (same `hexX`, layer moves by `±1`). -/
lemma step_dichotomy {a b : Vertex} (hab : adjacent a b) :
    (layer a = layer b ∧ (hexX b = hexX a + 1 ∨ hexX b = hexX a - 1)) ∨
    (hexX a = hexX b ∧ (layer b = layer a + 1 ∨ layer b = layer a - 1)) := by
  cases a with
  | up i j =>
    cases b with
    | up _ _ => simp [adjacent] at hab
    | down k l =>
      simp only [adjacent] at hab
      rcases hab with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · right
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [hexX]; omega
        · simp only [layer]; omega
      · left
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [layer]; omega
        · simp only [hexX]; omega
      · left
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [layer]; omega
        · simp only [hexX]; omega
  | down k l =>
    cases b with
    | down _ _ => simp [adjacent] at hab
    | up i j =>
      simp only [adjacent] at hab
      rcases hab with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · right
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [hexX]; omega
        · simp only [layer]; omega
      · left
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [layer]; omega
        · simp only [hexX]; omega
      · left
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [layer]; omega
        · simp only [hexX]; omega


/-- **Integer walk core lemma.** A finite injective walk on `ℤ` with steps `±1` is monotone:
it goes straight in one direction. This is the combinatorial fact that makes the width-one
strip a single line. -/
lemma int_walk_monotone {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℤ}
    (hinj : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n → f i = f j → i = j)
    (hstep : ∀ i, i + 1 < n → f (i + 1) = f i + 1 ∨ f (i + 1) = f i - 1) :
    (∀ i, i < n → f i = f 0 + (i : ℤ)) ∨ (∀ i, i < n → f i = f 0 - (i : ℤ)) := by
  have no_flip : ∀ k, k + 2 < n → ¬(f (k+1) = f k + 1 ∧ f (k+2) = f (k+1) - 1) ∧
      ¬(f (k+1) = f k - 1 ∧ f (k+2) = f (k+1) + 1) := by
    intro k hk
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have hval : f (k+2) = f k := by rw [h2, h1]; ring
      exact absurd (hinj (k+2) k (by omega) (by omega) hval) (by omega)
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have hval : f (k+2) = f k := by rw [h2, h1]; ring
      exact absurd (hinj (k+2) k (by omega) (by omega) hval) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with hn | hn
  · left
    intro i hi
    have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
    subst hi0; simp
  · rcases hstep 0 (by omega) with hplus | hminus
    · left
      have allplus : ∀ j, j + 1 < n → f (j+1) = f j + 1 := by
        intro j
        induction j with
        | zero => intro _; exact hplus
        | succ k ihk =>
          intro hjk
          have hprev : f (k+1) = f k + 1 := ihk (by omega)
          rcases hstep (k+1) hjk with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd ⟨hprev, h⟩ (no_flip k (by omega)).1
      intro i
      induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | _ i ih =>
        intro hi
        match i with
        | 0 => simp
        | k + 1 =>
          have hk : f (k+1) = f k + 1 := allplus k (by omega)
          have hk' : f k = f 0 + (k : ℤ) := ih k (by omega) (by omega)
          rw [hk, hk']
          push_cast
          ring
    · right
      have allminus : ∀ j, j + 1 < n → f (j+1) = f j - 1 := by
        intro j
        induction j with
        | zero => intro _; exact hminus
        | succ k ihk =>
          intro hjk
          have hprev : f (k+1) = f k - 1 := ihk (by omega)
          rcases hstep (k+1) hjk with h | h
          · exact absurd ⟨hprev, h⟩ (no_flip k (by omega)).2
          · exact h
      intro i
      induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | _ i ih =>
        intro hi
        match i with
        | 0 => simp
        | k + 1 =>
          have hk : f (k+1) = f k - 1 := allminus k (by omega)
          have hk' : f k = f 0 - (k : ℤ) := ih k (by omega) (by omega)
          rw [hk, hk']
          push_cast
          ring

open scoped BigOperators

/-- For a chain of adjacent vertices all on layer `0`, the `hexX` coordinates form an
injective `±1` walk. -/
lemma chain_hexX_walk {l : List Vertex}
    (hchain : l.IsChain adjacent) (hnd : l.Nodup)
    (hlay : ∀ v ∈ l, layer v = 0) :
    (∀ (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length) (hj : j < l.length),
        hexX (l[i]'hi) = hexX (l[j]'hj) → i = j) ∧
    (∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < l.length),
        hexX (l[i+1]'hi) = hexX (l[i]'(by omega)) + 1 ∨
        hexX (l[i+1]'hi) = hexX (l[i]'(by omega)) - 1) := by
  constructor
  · intro i j hi hj hX
    have hli : layer (l[i]'hi) = 0 := hlay _ (List.getElem_mem (l := l) hi)
    have hlj : layer (l[j]'hj) = 0 := hlay _ (List.getElem_mem (l := l) hj)
    have hveq : l[i]'hi = l[j]'hj := eq_of_hexX_layer hX (by rw [hli, hlj])
    by_contra hne
    exact absurd hveq (fun h => hne ((hnd.getElem_inj (hi := hi) (hj := hj)).mp h))
  · intro i hi
    have h1 : adjacent (l[i]'(by omega)) (l[i+1]'hi) := hchain.getElem i hi
    have hl1 : layer (l[i]'(by omega)) = 0 := hlay _ (List.getElem_mem (l := l) (by omega))
    have hl2 : layer (l[i+1]'hi) = 0 := hlay _ (List.getElem_mem (l := l) (by omega))
    exact hexX_step (by rw [hl1, hl2]) h1

open scoped BigOperators

lemma BridgePath.ext_vertices {h : ℕ} {p q : BridgePath h} (hv : p.vertices = q.vertices) :
    p = q := by
  cases p with
  | mk vp dp cp sp tp ip =>
    cases q with
    | mk vq dq cq sq tq iq =>
      simp only at hv
      subst hv
      congr 1

lemma layer_eq_zero_of_bridge1 {p : BridgePath 1} (v : Vertex) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices) :
    layer v = 0 := by
  have h := p.inStrip v hv
  have h1 : layer v < ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := h.2
  have h2 : 0 ≤ layer v := h.1
  omega

lemma length_pos_of_bridge {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : 0 < p.vertices.length :=
  List.length_pos_iff.mpr (ne_nil_of_vertices_nonempty p)

noncomputable def bridge1CoordFun (p : BridgePath 1) : ℕ → ℤ :=
  fun i => hexX (p.vertices.getD i (.up 0 0))

lemma bridge1CoordFun_eq (p : BridgePath 1) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < p.vertices.length) :
    bridge1CoordFun p i = hexX (p.vertices[i]'hi) := by
  unfold bridge1CoordFun
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem]

lemma bridge1_start (p : BridgePath 1) {h : 0 < p.vertices.length} :
    hexX (p.vertices[0]'h) = 0 := by
  have hsrc : p.vertices[0]? = some (.up 0 0) := by
    rw [← head?_eq_getElem?_zero]; exact p.source
  have e1 : p.vertices[0]? = some (p.vertices[0]'h) := List.getElem?_eq_getElem h
  rw [e1] at hsrc
  have hv : p.vertices[0]'h = .up 0 0 := Option.some.inj hsrc
  rw [hv]; exact hexX_up_zero

/-- The `hexX` coordinate of a width-one bridge path is affine: `+i` or `-i`. -/
lemma bridge1_hexX (p : BridgePath 1) :
    (∀ (i : ℕ) (_hi : i < p.vertices.length), bridge1CoordFun p i = (i : ℤ)) ∨
    (∀ (i : ℕ) (_hi : i < p.vertices.length), bridge1CoordFun p i = -(i : ℤ)) := by
  have hlen : 0 < p.vertices.length := length_pos_of_bridge p
  obtain ⟨hinj, hstep⟩ :=
    chain_hexX_walk p.connected p.distinct (fun v hv => layer_eq_zero_of_bridge1 v hv)
  have hinj' : ∀ i j, i < p.vertices.length → j < p.vertices.length →
      bridge1CoordFun p i = bridge1CoordFun p j → i = j := by
    intro i j hi hj hf
    rw [bridge1CoordFun_eq p hi, bridge1CoordFun_eq p hj] at hf
    exact hinj i j hi hj hf
  have hstep' : ∀ i, i + 1 < p.vertices.length →
      bridge1CoordFun p (i+1) = bridge1CoordFun p i + 1 ∨
      bridge1CoordFun p (i+1) = bridge1CoordFun p i - 1 := by
    intro i hi
    rw [bridge1CoordFun_eq p hi, bridge1CoordFun_eq p (by omega)]
    exact hstep i hi
  have hc0 : bridge1CoordFun p 0 = 0 := by
    rw [bridge1CoordFun_eq p hlen]; exact bridge1_start p
  obtain hm | hm := int_walk_monotone (n := p.vertices.length) hinj' hstep'
  · left
    intro i hi
    have h := hm i hi
    rw [hc0] at h
    simpa using h
  · right
    intro i hi
    have h := hm i hi
    rw [hc0] at h
    simpa using h

/-- A width-one bridge path has at least two vertices (`up 0 0` is not `down i 0`). -/
lemma bridge1_length_ge_two (p : BridgePath 1) : 2 ≤ p.vertices.length := by
  have hpos := length_pos_of_bridge p
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := p.terminal
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p.vertices.length 2 with h | h
  · have hlen1 : p.vertices.length = 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen1
    have hhead : p.vertices.head? = some a := by rw [ha]; rfl
    rw [p.source] at hhead
    have hav : a = Vertex.up 0 0 := Option.some.inj hhead.symm
    have hlast : p.vertices.getLast? = some a := by rw [ha]; rfl
    rw [hi] at hlast
    have hcontra : Vertex.down i (((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = Vertex.up 0 0 := by
      have hd : Vertex.down i (((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = a := Option.some.inj hlast
      rw [hd, hav]
    exact absurd hcontra (by simp)
  · exact h

/-- The second `hexX` coordinate of a width-one bridge path is `±1`. -/
lemma bridge1_second (p : BridgePath 1) :
    bridge1CoordFun p 1 = 1 ∨ bridge1CoordFun p 1 = -1 := by
  have h2 := bridge1_length_ge_two p
  rcases bridge1_hexX p with hp | hp
  · left; have := hp 1 (by omega); simpa using this
  · right; have := hp 1 (by omega); simpa using this

/-- **Determination by length and second coordinate.** -/
lemma bridge1_det {p q : BridgePath 1}
    (hlen : p.vertices.length = q.vertices.length)
    (hsecond : bridge1CoordFun p 1 = bridge1CoordFun q 1) :
    p.vertices = q.vertices := by
  have h2q : 2 ≤ q.vertices.length := by have := bridge1_length_ge_two q; omega
  have hlen' : 2 ≤ p.vertices.length := bridge1_length_ge_two p
  have sign : ∀ i, i < p.vertices.length → bridge1CoordFun p i = bridge1CoordFun q i := by
    intro i hi
    rcases bridge1_hexX p with hp | hp <;> rcases bridge1_hexX q with hq | hq
    · rw [hp i hi, hq i (by omega)]
    · exfalso
      have h1 := hp 1 (by omega)
      have h2' := hq 1 (by omega)
      rw [h1, h2'] at hsecond
      omega
    · exfalso
      have h1 := hp 1 (by omega)
      have h2' := hq 1 (by omega)
      rw [h1, h2'] at hsecond
      omega
    · rw [hp i hi, hq i (by omega)]
  refine List.ext_getElem hlen ?_
  intro i hi hiq
  have hlp : layer (p.vertices[i]'hi) = 0 :=
    layer_eq_zero_of_bridge1 _ (List.getElem_mem (l := p.vertices) hi)
  have hlq : layer (q.vertices[i]'hiq) = 0 :=
    layer_eq_zero_of_bridge1 _ (List.getElem_mem (l := q.vertices) hiq)
  refine eq_of_hexX_layer ?_ (by rw [hlp, hlq])
  rw [← bridge1CoordFun_eq p hi, ← bridge1CoordFun_eq q hiq]
  exact sign i hi

/-- **Width-one counting bound**: at most two bridge paths of any prescribed length. -/
theorem bridge1_card_le_two (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath 1))
    (hlen : ∀ p ∈ s, p.vertices.length = n) : s.card ≤ 2 := by
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun p : BridgePath 1 => bridge1CoordFun p 1) (s : Set (BridgePath 1)) := by
    intro p hp q hq heq
    have hpn : p.vertices.length = n := hlen p hp
    have hqn : q.vertices.length = n := hlen q hq
    exact BridgePath.ext_vertices (bridge1_det (by omega) heq)
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : BridgePath 1 => bridge1CoordFun p 1) (s : Set (BridgePath 1))
      ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ) := by
    intro p _
    rcases bridge1_second p with h | h <;> simp [h]
  calc s.card ≤ ({-1, 1} : Finset ℤ).card := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ hmaps hinj
    _ ≤ 2 := Finset.card_le_two

/-- **Width-one instance of the missing strip-growth estimate.**  This is the `h = 1` case of
`StripGrowthBelowMu`, fully proved: `C = 2`, `β = 1`, and `1 < 2 cos (π/8)`. -/
theorem stripGrowthAtOne :
    ∃ C β : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ β < 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath 1)),
        (∀ p ∈ s, p.vertices.length = n) → (s.card : ℝ) ≤ C * β ^ n := by
  refine ⟨2, 1, by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hpos : 0 < Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) := by
      apply Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
      constructor <;> nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := by
      calc Real.sqrt 2 < Real.sqrt 4 := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        _ = 2 := by norm_num
    have hle : Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) < 2 := by
      calc Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) < Real.sqrt 4 :=
            Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by positivity) (by linarith)
        _ = 2 := by norm_num
    have hgt : 1 < Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) := by
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) < 2 + Real.sqrt 2 := by
        have := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2; linarith
      calc (1 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 := by simp

```lean
open scoped BigOperators

/-- Integer column coordinate of the frozen honeycomb vertices. -/
def bridgeBoxColumn : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- A path lies in the two-column-slab box indexed by `-R, ..., R`. -/
def bridgeInColumnBox {h : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
    -(2 * (R : ℤ)) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
      bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ 2 * (R : ℤ) + 1

/-- Every finite family of finite bridge paths lies in one common column box. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox {h : ℕ} (s : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p := by
  classical
  let radius : BridgePath h → ℕ := fun p =>
    p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
  let R : ℕ := s.sup radius
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro p hp v hv
  have hpR : radius p ≤ R := Finset.le_sup hp
  have hvR : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ radius p :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun v : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
      (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)
  have hnat : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ R := hvR.trans hpR
  have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have habs : |bridgeBoxColumn v| ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using hcast
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
  constructor <;> omega

/-- A bound uniform in the box radius bounds every finite bridge-family sum. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    ∀ s : Finset (BridgePath h), ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K := by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox s
  exact H R s hR

/-- Conditional zeroth-mass reduction. The uniform finite-box bound is an input;
this theorem does not establish that bound or any first length moment. -/
theorem bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    Summable (weight (h := h)) := by
  exact summable_of_sum_le (fun p => bridgeWeight_nonneg p)
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)

/-- The same still-unproved finite-box input also bounds the full bridge mass. -/
theorem bridgeMass_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    bridgeMass h ≤ K := by
  exact (bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H).tsum_le_of_sum_le
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)
```

```lean
open scoped BigOperators

/-- Integer column coordinate of the frozen honeycomb vertices. -/
def bridgeBoxColumn : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- A path lies in the two-column-slab box indexed by `-R, ..., R`. -/
def bridgeInColumnBox {h : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
    -(2 * (R : ℤ)) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
      bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ 2 * (R : ℤ) + 1

/-- Every finite family of finite bridge paths lies in one common column box. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox {h : ℕ} (s : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p := by
  classical
  let radius : BridgePath h → ℕ := fun p =>
    p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
  let R : ℕ := s.sup radius
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro p hp v hv
  have hpR : radius p ≤ R := Finset.le_sup hp
  have hvR : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ radius p :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun v : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
      (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)
  have hnat : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ R := hvR.trans hpR
  have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have habs : |bridgeBoxColumn v| ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using hcast
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
  constructor <;> omega

/-- A bound uniform in the box radius bounds every finite bridge-family sum. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    ∀ s : Finset (BridgePath h), ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K := by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox s
  exact H R s hR

/-- Conditional zeroth-mass reduction. The uniform finite-box bound is an input;
this theorem does not establish that bound or any first length moment. -/
theorem bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    Summable (weight (h := h)) := by
  exact summable_of_sum_le (fun p => bridgeWeight_nonneg p)
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)

/-- The same still-unproved finite-box input also bounds the full bridge mass. -/
theorem bridgeMass_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    bridgeMass h ≤ K := by
  exact (bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H).tsum_le_of_sum_le
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)
```

```lean
namespace TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

/-- A finite nonnegative factorization of `c (a+b)` is enough to upgrade its
zeroth moment to its first moment. States whose left or right sequence vanishes
contribute zero, so no reachability or trimming premise is required. -/
theorem summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {c : ℕ → ℝ} {L R : ℕ → ι → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ L n i) (hR : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ R n i)
    (hfactor : ∀ a b, c (a + b) = ∑ i, L a i * R b i)
    (hc : Summable c) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * c n) := by
  classical
  have hterm (a b : ℕ) (i : ι) : L a i * R b i ≤ c (a + b) := by
    rw [hfactor a b]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hL a j) (hR b j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hprod (i : ι) : Summable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => L p.1 i * R p.2 i) := by
    by_cases hzeroL : ∀ a, L a i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroL, zero_mul] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    by_cases hzeroR : ∀ b, R b i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroR, mul_zero] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    push Not at hzeroL hzeroR
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hzeroL
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hzeroR
    have hleftScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i * R b i) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL n i) (hR b i))
        (fun n => hterm n b i) ((summable_nat_add_iff b).2 hc)
    have hrightScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L a i * R n i) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL a i) (hR n i)) (fun n => hterm a n i) ?_
      simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using ((summable_nat_add_iff a).2 hc)
    have hleft : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i) :=
      (summable_mul_right_iff hb).1 hleftScaled
    have hright : Summable (fun n : ℕ => R n i) :=
      (summable_mul_left_iff ha).1 hrightScaled
    exact hleft.mul_of_nonneg hright (fun n => hL n i) (fun n => hR n i)
  have hconv (i : ι) :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul
      (f := fun n : ℕ => L n i) (g := fun n : ℕ => R n i) (hprod i)
  have hsum : Summable
      (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum (fun i _ => hconv i)
  have hweighted : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n) := by
    refine hsum.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, ∑ i, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) =
          ∑ _p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, c n := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        rw [← hfactor p.1 p.2, Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp]
      _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.Nat.card_antidiagonal, nsmul_eq_mul]
  refine (hweighted.sub hc).congr fun n => ?_
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  ring

/-- The scalar Green coefficients of a finite nonnegative transfer matrix. -/
def matrixMass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ n) *ᵥ v)

/-- For a finite entrywise nonnegative matrix and nonnegative endpoint vectors,
summability of the single scalar Green series implies its first-moment
summability, even when invisible states have divergent matrix Green series. -/
theorem summable_matrix_firstMoment
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i)
    (hc : Summable (matrixMass A u v)) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * matrixMass A u v n) := by
  apply summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    (L := fun n => u ᵥ* (A ^ n)) (R := fun n => (A ^ n) *ᵥ v)
    (hc := hc)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (hu j) (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n j i)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n i j) (hv j)
  · intro a b
    change u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ (a + b)) *ᵥ v) =
      (u ᵥ* (A ^ a)) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ b) *ᵥ v)
    rw [pow_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]


end TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment
```

```lean
namespace TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

/-- A finite nonnegative factorization of `c (a+b)` is enough to upgrade its
zeroth moment to its first moment. States whose left or right sequence vanishes
contribute zero, so no reachability or trimming premise is required. -/
theorem summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {c : ℕ → ℝ} {L R : ℕ → ι → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ L n i) (hR : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ R n i)
    (hfactor : ∀ a b, c (a + b) = ∑ i, L a i * R b i)
    (hc : Summable c) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * c n) := by
  classical
  have hterm (a b : ℕ) (i : ι) : L a i * R b i ≤ c (a + b) := by
    rw [hfactor a b]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hL a j) (hR b j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hprod (i : ι) : Summable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => L p.1 i * R p.2 i) := by
    by_cases hzeroL : ∀ a, L a i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroL, zero_mul] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    by_cases hzeroR : ∀ b, R b i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroR, mul_zero] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    push Not at hzeroL hzeroR
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hzeroL
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hzeroR
    have hleftScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i * R b i) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL n i) (hR b i))
        (fun n => hterm n b i) ((summable_nat_add_iff b).2 hc)
    have hrightScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L a i * R n i) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL a i) (hR n i)) (fun n => hterm a n i) ?_
      simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using ((summable_nat_add_iff a).2 hc)
    have hleft : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i) :=
      (summable_mul_right_iff hb).1 hleftScaled
    have hright : Summable (fun n : ℕ => R n i) :=
      (summable_mul_left_iff ha).1 hrightScaled
    exact hleft.mul_of_nonneg hright (fun n => hL n i) (fun n => hR n i)
  have hconv (i : ι) :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul
      (f := fun n : ℕ => L n i) (g := fun n : ℕ => R n i) (hprod i)
  have hsum : Summable
      (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum (fun i _ => hconv i)
  have hweighted : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n) := by
    refine hsum.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, ∑ i, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) =
          ∑ _p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, c n := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        rw [← hfactor p.1 p.2, Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp]
      _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.Nat.card_antidiagonal, nsmul_eq_mul]
  refine (hweighted.sub hc).congr fun n => ?_
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  ring

/-- The scalar Green coefficients of a finite nonnegative transfer matrix. -/
def matrixMass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ n) *ᵥ v)

/-- For a finite entrywise nonnegative matrix and nonnegative endpoint vectors,
summability of the single scalar Green series implies its first-moment
summability, even when invisible states have divergent matrix Green series. -/
theorem summable_matrix_firstMoment
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i)
    (hc : Summable (matrixMass A u v)) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * matrixMass A u v n) := by
  apply summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    (L := fun n => u ᵥ* (A ^ n)) (R := fun n => (A ^ n) *ᵥ v)
    (hc := hc)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (hu j) (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n j i)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n i j) (hv j)
  · intro a b
    change u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ (a + b)) *ᵥ v) =
      (u ᵥ* (A ^ a)) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ b) *ᵥ v)
    rw [pow_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]


end TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment
```

```lean
noncomputable def bridgeLayerColumnCode (v : Vertex) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (layer v, bridgeBoxColumn v)

theorem bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective :
    Function.Injective bridgeLayerColumnCode := by
  intro v w h
  cases v <;> cases w <;>
    simp only [bridgeLayerColumnCode, layer, bridgeBoxColumn, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  · congr 1 <;> omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · congr 1 <;> omega

/-- A nodup strip list has at most one vertex for each allowed layer-column pair.
No connectivity, source, terminal, or unproved counting estimate is used. -/
theorem bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet
    {h : ℕ} (vs : List Vertex) (hnodup : vs.Nodup)
    (hstrip : ∀ v ∈ vs, 0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ))
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ vs, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    vs.length ≤ h * columns.card := by
  classical
  let image := vs.toFinset.image bridgeLayerColumnCode
  let box := (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (h : ℤ)) ×ˢ columns
  have hsub : image ⊆ box := by
    intro pair hpair
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpair
    have hvlist : v ∈ vs := List.mem_toFinset.mp hv
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_Ico.mpr (hstrip v hvlist), hcolumns v hvlist⟩
  have hcard : image.card = vs.length := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective]
    exact List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
  have hboxcard : box.card = h * columns.card := by
    simp only [box, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico, sub_zero, Int.toNat_natCast]
  calc
    vs.length = image.card := hcard.symm
    _ ≤ box.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = h * columns.card := hboxcard
```

```lean
/-- Integer column coordinate of the frozen honeycomb vertices. -/
def bridgeBoxColumn : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- A path lies in the two-column-slab box indexed by `-R, ..., R`. -/
def bridgeInColumnBox {h : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
    -(2 * (R : ℤ)) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
      bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ 2 * (R : ℤ) + 1

/-- Every finite family of finite bridge paths lies in one common column box. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox {h : ℕ} (s : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p := by
  classical
  let radius : BridgePath h → ℕ := fun p =>
    p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
  let R : ℕ := s.sup radius
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro p hp v hv
  have hpR : radius p ≤ R := Finset.le_sup hp
  have hvR : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ radius p :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun v : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
      (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)
  have hnat : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ R := hvR.trans hpR
  have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have habs : |bridgeBoxColumn v| ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using hcast
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
  constructor <;> omega

/-- A bound uniform in the box radius bounds every finite bridge-family sum. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    ∀ s : Finset (BridgePath h), ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K := by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox s
  exact H R s hR

/-- Conditional zeroth-mass reduction. The uniform finite-box bound is an input;
this theorem does not establish that bound or any first length moment. -/
```

```lean
contribute zero, so no reachability or trimming premise is required. -/
theorem summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization

    (hL : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ L n i) (hR : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ R n i)
    (hfactor : ∀ a b, c (a + b) = ∑ i, L a i * R b i)
    (hc : Summable c) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * c n) := by

    rw [hfactor a b]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hL a j) (hR b j))

    by_cases hzeroL : ∀ a, L a i = 0

    by_cases hzeroR : ∀ b, R b i = 0

    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hzeroR

    have hrightScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L a i * R n i) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le

      simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using ((summable_nat_add_iff a).2 hc)
    have hleft : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i) :=
      (summable_mul_right_iff hb).1 hleftScaled

      (summable_mul_left_iff ha).1 hrightScaled

/-- The scalar Green coefficients of a finite nonnegative transfer matrix. -/
def matrixMass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ n) *ᵥ v)

/-- For a finite entrywise nonnegative matrix and nonnegative endpoint vectors,
summability of the single scalar Green series implies its first-moment
summability, even when invisible states have divergent matrix Green series. -/
theorem summable_matrix_firstMoment
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i)
    (hc : Summable (matrixMass A u v)) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * matrixMass A u v n) := by
  apply summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    (L := fun n => u ᵥ* (A ^ n)) (R := fun n => (A ^ n) *ᵥ v)
    (hc := hc)

    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (hu j) (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n j i)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n i j) (hv j)
  · intro a b
    change u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ (a + b)) *ᵥ v) =
      (u ᵥ* (A ^ a)) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ b) *ᵥ v)
    rw [pow_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
```

```lean
/-- The frozen layer and integer column identify a honeycomb vertex uniquely. -/
noncomputable def bridgeLayerColumnCode (v : Vertex) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (layer v, bridgeBoxColumn v)

theorem bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective :
    Function.Injective bridgeLayerColumnCode := by
  intro v w h
  cases v <;> cases w <;>
    simp only [bridgeLayerColumnCode, layer, bridgeBoxColumn, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  · congr 1 <;> omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · congr 1 <;> omega

/-- A nodup strip list has at most one vertex for each allowed layer-column pair.
No connectivity, source, terminal, or unproved counting estimate is used. -/
theorem bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet
    {h : ℕ} (vs : List Vertex) (hnodup : vs.Nodup)
    (hstrip : ∀ v ∈ vs, 0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ))
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ vs, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    vs.length ≤ h * columns.card := by
  classical
  let image := vs.toFinset.image bridgeLayerColumnCode
  let box := (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (h : ℤ)) ×ˢ columns
  have hsub : image ⊆ box := by
    intro pair hpair
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpair
    have hvlist : v ∈ vs := List.mem_toFinset.mp hv
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_Ico.mpr (hstrip v hvlist), hcolumns v hvlist⟩
  have hcard : image.card = vs.length := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective]
    exact List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
  have hboxcard : box.card = h * columns.card := by
    simp only [box, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico, sub_zero, Int.toNat_natCast]
  calc
    vs.length = image.card := hcard.symm
    _ ≤ box.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = h * columns.card := hboxcard

theorem bridgeLength_le_columnSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card :=
  bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet p.vertices p.distinct p.inStrip columns hcolumns

/-- The interval may even be empty; its natural cardinality handles that case. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnInterval {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (a b : ℤ)
    (hbox : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, a ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧ bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ b) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (b + 1 - a).toNat := by
  have h := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p (Finset.Icc a b)
    (fun v hv => Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (hbox v hv))
  simpa only [Int.card_Icc] using h

/-- Exact geometric size bound for the already defined symmetric slab box. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnBox {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (R : ℕ)
    (hbox : bridgeInColumnBox R p) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (4 * R + 2) := by
  have hlength := bridgeLength_le_columnInterval p
    (-(2 * (R : ℤ))) (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1) hbox
  have hwidth : (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1 + 1 - -(2 * (R : ℤ))).toNat = 4 * R + 2 := by
    omega
  simpa only [hwidth] using hlength

/-- Index of the two-column slab containing a vertex, using integer floor division. -/
def bridgeBoxSlab (v : Vertex) : ℤ := bridgeBoxColumn v / 2

/-- A finite set of two-column slabs contains at most `2*h` vertices per slab. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_slabSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (slabs : Finset ℤ)
    (hslabs : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxSlab v ∈ slabs) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ 2 * h * slabs.card := by
  classical
  let slots := slabs ×ˢ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) 2
  let columns := slots.image (fun q : ℤ × ℤ => 2 * q.1 + q.2)
  have hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns := by
    intro v hv
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨(bridgeBoxColumn v / 2, bridgeBoxColumn v % 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨hslabs v hv, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
    · omega
  have hcard : columns.card ≤ slabs.card * 2 := by
    calc
      columns.card ≤ slots.card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = slabs.card * 2 := by
        simp only [slots, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico]
        rfl
  calc
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p columns hcolumns
    _ ≤ h * (slabs.card * 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left h hcard
    _ = 2 * h * slabs.card := by ac_rfl

def bridgeColumnRadius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : ℕ :=
  p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)

theorem bridgeColumn_natAbs_le_radius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
```

```lean
namespace TheoremOS.ProfileSummability

open scoped BigOperators

/-- The real mass of an exact profile fiber. Its use as a coefficient requires
fiber convergence; the theorems below derive it from whole-family summability
or request `HasSum`, rather than relying on a possibly divergent `tsum`. -/
noncomputable def fiberMass {α : Type*} (w : α → ℝ) (profile : α → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' a : {a : α // profile a = n}, w a.val

theorem summable_fiberMass_of_summable
    {α : Type*} {w : α → ℝ} (profile : α → ℕ) (hw : Summable w) :
    Summable (fiberMass w profile) := by
  exact (hw.hasSum.tsum_fiberwise profile).summable


/-- Exact convergent fiber sums may be lifted through any nonnegative profile
multiplier. Fibers may be infinite; each is required to have the stated sum. -/
theorem summable_profileScale_of_hasSum
    {α : Type*} {w : α → ℝ} {profile : α → ℕ} {c scale : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a) (hscale : ∀ n, 0 ≤ scale n)
    (hfiber : ∀ n, HasSum (fun a : {a : α // profile a = n} => w a.val) (c n))
    (hc : Summable (fun n => scale n * c n)) :
    Summable (fun a => scale (profile a) * w a) := by
  let f : (Σ n : ℕ, {a : α // profile a = n}) → ℝ :=
    fun p => scale p.1 * w p.2.val
  have hscaled (n : ℕ) :
      HasSum (fun a : {a : α // profile a = n} => scale n * w a.val)
        (scale n * c n) := (hfiber n).mul_left (scale n)
  have hsigma : Summable f :=
    (summable_sigma_of_nonneg (f := f)
      (fun p => mul_nonneg (hscale p.1) (hw p.2.val))).2
      ⟨fun n => (hscaled n).summable,
        hc.congr (fun n => (hscaled n).tsum_eq.symm)⟩
  have hreindex : Summable
      (fun p : Σ n : ℕ, {a : α // profile a = n} =>
        scale (profile p.2.val) * w p.2.val) := by
    refine hsigma.congr fun p => ?_
    change scale p.1 * w p.2.val = scale (profile p.2.val) * w p.2.val
    rw [p.2.property]
  exact (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv profile).summable_iff.mp hreindex
```

```lean
/-- Integer column coordinate of the frozen honeycomb vertices. -/
def bridgeBoxColumn : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- A path lies in the two-column-slab box indexed by `-R, ..., R`. -/
def bridgeInColumnBox {h : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
    -(2 * (R : ℤ)) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
      bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ 2 * (R : ℤ) + 1

/-- Every finite family of finite bridge paths lies in one common column box. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox {h : ℕ} (s : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p := by
  classical
  let radius : BridgePath h → ℕ := fun p =>
    p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
  let R : ℕ := s.sup radius
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro p hp v hv
  have hpR : radius p ≤ R := Finset.le_sup hp
  have hvR : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ radius p :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun v : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
      (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)
  have hnat : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ R := hvR.trans hpR
  have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have habs : |bridgeBoxColumn v| ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using hcast
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
  constructor <;> omega

/-- A bound uniform in the box radius bounds every finite bridge-family sum. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    ∀ s : Finset (BridgePath h), ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K := by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox s
  exact H R s hR
```

```lean
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * matrixMass A u v n) := by
  apply summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    (L := fun n => u ᵥ* (A ^ n)) (R := fun n => (A ^ n) *ᵥ v)
    (hc := hc)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (hu j) (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n j i)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n i j) (hv j)
  · intro a b
    change u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ (a + b)) *ᵥ v) =
      (u ᵥ* (A ^ a)) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ b) *ᵥ v)
    rw [pow_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
```

```lean
/-- The frozen layer and integer column identify a honeycomb vertex uniquely. -/
noncomputable def bridgeLayerColumnCode (v : Vertex) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (layer v, bridgeBoxColumn v)

theorem bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective :
    Function.Injective bridgeLayerColumnCode := by
  intro v w h
  cases v <;> cases w <;>
    simp only [bridgeLayerColumnCode, layer, bridgeBoxColumn, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  · congr 1 <;> omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · congr 1 <;> omega

/-- A nodup strip list has at most one vertex for each allowed layer-column pair.
No connectivity, source, terminal, or unproved counting estimate is used. -/
theorem bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet
    {h : ℕ} (vs : List Vertex) (hnodup : vs.Nodup)
    (hstrip : ∀ v ∈ vs, 0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ))
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ vs, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    vs.length ≤ h * columns.card := by
  classical
  let image := vs.toFinset.image bridgeLayerColumnCode
  let box := (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (h : ℤ)) ×ˢ columns
  have hsub : image ⊆ box := by
    intro pair hpair
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpair
    have hvlist : v ∈ vs := List.mem_toFinset.mp hv
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_Ico.mpr (hstrip v hvlist), hcolumns v hvlist⟩
  have hcard : image.card = vs.length := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective]
    exact List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
  have hboxcard : box.card = h * columns.card := by
    simp only [box, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico, sub_zero, Int.toNat_natCast]
  calc
    vs.length = image.card := hcard.symm
    _ ≤ box.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = h * columns.card := hboxcard

theorem bridgeLength_le_columnSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card :=
  bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet p.vertices p.distinct p.inStrip columns hcolumns

/-- The interval may even be empty; its natural cardinality handles that case. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnInterval {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (a b : ℤ)
    (hbox : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, a ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧ bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ b) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (b + 1 - a).toNat := by
  have h := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p (Finset.Icc a b)
    (fun v hv => Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (hbox v hv))
  simpa only [Int.card_Icc] using h

/-- Exact geometric size bound for the already defined symmetric slab box. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnBox {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (R : ℕ)
    (hbox : bridgeInColumnBox R p) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (4 * R + 2) := by
  have hlength := bridgeLength_le_columnInterval p
    (-(2 * (R : ℤ))) (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1) hbox
  have hwidth : (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1 + 1 - -(2 * (R : ℤ))).toNat = 4 * R + 2 := by
    omega
  simpa only [hwidth] using hlength

/-- Index of the two-column slab containing a vertex, using integer floor division. -/
def bridgeBoxSlab (v : Vertex) : ℤ := bridgeBoxColumn v / 2

/-- A finite set of two-column slabs contains at most `2*h` vertices per slab. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_slabSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (slabs : Finset ℤ)
    (hslabs : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxSlab v ∈ slabs) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ 2 * h * slabs.card := by
  classical
  let slots := slabs ×ˢ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) 2
  let columns := slots.image (fun q : ℤ × ℤ => 2 * q.1 + q.2)
  have hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns := by
    intro v hv
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨(bridgeBoxColumn v / 2, bridgeBoxColumn v % 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨hslabs v hv, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
    · omega
  have hcard : columns.card ≤ slabs.card * 2 := by
    calc
      columns.card ≤ slots.card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = slabs.card * 2 := by
        simp only [slots, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico]
        rfl
  calc
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p columns hcolumns
    _ ≤ h * (slabs.card * 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left h hcard
    _ = 2 * h * slabs.card := by ac_rfl

def bridgeOccupiedSlabs {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : Finset ℤ :=
  p.vertices.toFinset.image bridgeBoxSlab

/-- In particular, a transfer encoding counting occupied slabs has this length bound. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_occupiedSlabs {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ 2 * h * (bridgeOccupiedSlabs p).card := by
  apply bridgeLength_le_slabSet
  intro v hv
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, rfl⟩

/-- The actual maximum absolute column of a finite vertex list. -/
def bridgeColumnRadius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : ℕ :=
  p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)

theorem bridgeColumn_natAbs_le_radius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (v : Vertex) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices) :
    (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ bridgeColumnRadius p :=
  Finset.le_sup (f := fun w : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn w).natAbs)
    (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)

/-- A length profile using the path's actual maximum absolute column. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnRadius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (2 * bridgeColumnRadius p + 1) := by
  have hbox : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
      -(bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
        bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ (bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) := by
    intro v hv
    have hnat := bridgeColumn_natAbs_le_radius p v hv
    have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) := by
      omega
    have hhi := Int.le_natAbs (a := bridgeBoxColumn v)
    have hlo := Int.le_natAbs (a := -bridgeBoxColumn v)
    simp only [Int.natAbs_neg] at hlo
    constructor <;> omega
  have hlength := bridgeLength_le_columnInterval p
    (-(bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ)) (bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) hbox
  have hwidth : ((bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) + 1 - -(bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ)).toNat =
      2 * bridgeColumnRadius p + 1 := by omega
  simpa only [hwidth] using hlength
```

```lean
open scoped BigOperators

/-- The real mass of an exact profile fiber. Its use as a coefficient requires
fiber convergence; the theorems below derive it from whole-family summability
or request `HasSum`, rather than relying on a possibly divergent `tsum`. -/
noncomputable def fiberMass {α : Type*} (w : α → ℝ) (profile : α → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' a : {a : α // profile a = n}, w a.val

theorem summable_fiberMass_of_summable
    {α : Type*} {w : α → ℝ} (profile : α → ℕ) (hw : Summable w) :
    Summable (fiberMass w profile) := by
  exact (hw.hasSum.tsum_fiberwise profile).summable


/-- Exact convergent fiber sums may be lifted through any nonnegative profile
multiplier. Fibers may be infinite; each is required to have the stated sum. -/
theorem summable_profileScale_of_hasSum
    {α : Type*} {w : α → ℝ} {profile : α → ℕ} {c scale : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a) (hscale : ∀ n, 0 ≤ scale n)
    (hfiber : ∀ n, HasSum (fun a : {a : α // profile a = n} => w a.val) (c n))
    (hc : Summable (fun n => scale n * c n)) :
    Summable (fun a => scale (profile a) * w a) := by
  let f : (Σ n : ℕ, {a : α // profile a = n}) → ℝ :=
    fun p => scale p.1 * w p.2.val
  have hscaled (n : ℕ) :
      HasSum (fun a : {a : α // profile a = n} => scale n * w a.val)
        (scale n * c n) := (hfiber n).mul_left (scale n)
  have hsigma : Summable f :=
    (summable_sigma_of_nonneg (f := f)
      (fun p => mul_nonneg (hscale p.1) (hw p.2.val))).2
      ⟨fun n => (hscaled n).summable,
        hc.congr (fun n => (hscaled n).tsum_eq.symm)⟩
  have hreindex : Summable
      (fun p : Σ n : ℕ, {a : α // profile a = n} =>
        scale (profile p.2.val) * w p.2.val) := by
    refine hsigma.congr fun p => ?_
    change scale p.1 * w p.2.val = scale (profile p.2.val) * w p.2.val
    rw [p.2.property]
  exact (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv profile).summable_iff.mp hreindex


/-- A first moment in an arbitrary natural profile dominates a size moment
whenever `size <= C * (profile+1)`. The shift handles zero/offset profiles. -/
theorem summable_sizeWeight_of_hasSum

  have hshift : Summable (fun n : ℕ => C * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * c n) := by
    refine ((hmoment.add hc).mul_left C).congr fun n => ?_
    ring
  have hscale : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ C * ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=

  have hdom : Summable (fun a => C * ((profile a : ℝ) + 1) * w a) :=
```

```lean
theorem bridgeVertices_eq_of_columnWord {h : ℕ} (p q : BridgePath h)
```

```lean
/-- Integer column coordinate of the frozen honeycomb vertices. -/
def bridgeBoxColumn : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- A path lies in the two-column-slab box indexed by `-R, ..., R`. -/
def bridgeInColumnBox {h : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
    -(2 * (R : ℤ)) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
      bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ 2 * (R : ℤ) + 1

/-- Every finite family of finite bridge paths lies in one common column box. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox {h : ℕ} (s : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p := by
  classical
  let radius : BridgePath h → ℕ := fun p =>
    p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
  let R : ℕ := s.sup radius
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro p hp v hv
  have hpR : radius p ≤ R := Finset.le_sup hp
  have hvR : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ radius p :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun v : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
      (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)
  have hnat : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ R := hvR.trans hpR
  have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have habs : |bridgeBoxColumn v| ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using hcast
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
  constructor <;> omega

/-- A bound uniform in the box radius bounds every finite bridge-family sum. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    ∀ s : Finset (BridgePath h), ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K := by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox s
  exact H R s hR

/-- Conditional zeroth-mass reduction. The uniform finite-box bound is an input;
this theorem does not establish that bound or any first length moment. -/
theorem bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    Summable (weight (h := h)) := by
  exact summable_of_sum_le (fun p => bridgeWeight_nonneg p)
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)
```

```lean
theorem summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {c : ℕ → ℝ} {L R : ℕ → ι → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ L n i) (hR : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ R n i)

    rw [hfactor a b]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hL a j) (hR b j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hprod (i : ι) : Summable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => L p.1 i * R p.2 i) := by
    by_cases hzeroL : ∀ a, L a i = 0
```

```lean
/-- The frozen layer and integer column identify a honeycomb vertex uniquely. -/
noncomputable def bridgeLayerColumnCode (v : Vertex) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (layer v, bridgeBoxColumn v)

theorem bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective :
    Function.Injective bridgeLayerColumnCode := by
  intro v w h
  cases v <;> cases w <;>
    simp only [bridgeLayerColumnCode, layer, bridgeBoxColumn, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  · congr 1 <;> omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · congr 1 <;> omega

/-- A nodup strip list has at most one vertex for each allowed layer-column pair.
No connectivity, source, terminal, or unproved counting estimate is used. -/
theorem bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet
    {h : ℕ} (vs : List Vertex) (hnodup : vs.Nodup)
    (hstrip : ∀ v ∈ vs, 0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ))
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ vs, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    vs.length ≤ h * columns.card := by
  classical
  let image := vs.toFinset.image bridgeLayerColumnCode
  let box := (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (h : ℤ)) ×ˢ columns
  have hsub : image ⊆ box := by
    intro pair hpair
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpair
    have hvlist : v ∈ vs := List.mem_toFinset.mp hv
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_Ico.mpr (hstrip v hvlist), hcolumns v hvlist⟩
  have hcard : image.card = vs.length := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective]
    exact List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
  have hboxcard : box.card = h * columns.card := by
    simp only [box, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico, sub_zero, Int.toNat_natCast]
  calc
    vs.length = image.card := hcard.symm
    _ ≤ box.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = h * columns.card := hboxcard

theorem bridgeLength_le_columnSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card :=
  bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet p.vertices p.distinct p.inStrip columns hcolumns

/-- The interval may even be empty; its natural cardinality handles that case. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnInterval {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (a b : ℤ)
    (hbox : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, a ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧ bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ b) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (b + 1 - a).toNat := by
  have h := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p (Finset.Icc a b)
    (fun v hv => Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (hbox v hv))
  simpa only [Int.card_Icc] using h

/-- Exact geometric size bound for the already defined symmetric slab box. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnBox {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (R : ℕ)
    (hbox : bridgeInColumnBox R p) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (4 * R + 2) := by
  have hlength := bridgeLength_le_columnInterval p
    (-(2 * (R : ℤ))) (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1) hbox
  have hwidth : (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1 + 1 - -(2 * (R : ℤ))).toNat = 4 * R + 2 := by
    omega
  simpa only [hwidth] using hlength

/-- Index of the two-column slab containing a vertex, using integer floor division. -/
def bridgeBoxSlab (v : Vertex) : ℤ := bridgeBoxColumn v / 2

/-- A finite set of two-column slabs contains at most `2*h` vertices per slab. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_slabSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (slabs : Finset ℤ)
    (hslabs : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxSlab v ∈ slabs) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ 2 * h * slabs.card := by
  classical
  let slots := slabs ×ˢ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) 2
  let columns := slots.image (fun q : ℤ × ℤ => 2 * q.1 + q.2)
  have hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns := by
    intro v hv
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨(bridgeBoxColumn v / 2, bridgeBoxColumn v % 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨hslabs v hv, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
    · omega
  have hcard : columns.card ≤ slabs.card * 2 := by
    calc
      columns.card ≤ slots.card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = slabs.card * 2 := by
        simp only [slots, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico]
        rfl
  calc
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p columns hcolumns
    _ ≤ h * (slabs.card * 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left h hcard
    _ = 2 * h * slabs.card := by ac_rfl

def bridgeOccupiedSlabs {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : Finset ℤ :=
  p.vertices.toFinset.image bridgeBoxSlab

/-- In particular, a transfer encoding counting occupied slabs has this length bound. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_occupiedSlabs {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ 2 * h * (bridgeOccupiedSlabs p).card := by
  apply bridgeLength_le_slabSet
  intro v hv
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, rfl⟩

/-- The actual maximum absolute column of a finite vertex list. -/
def bridgeColumnRadius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : ℕ :=
  p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)

theorem bridgeColumn_natAbs_le_radius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (v : Vertex) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices) :
    (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ bridgeColumnRadius p :=
  Finset.le_sup (f := fun w : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn w).natAbs)
    (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)

/-- A length profile using the path's actual maximum absolute column. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnRadius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (2 * bridgeColumnRadius p + 1) := by
  have hbox : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
      -(bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
        bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ (bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) := by
    intro v hv
    have hnat := bridgeColumn_natAbs_le_radius p v hv
    have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) := by
      omega
    have hhi := Int.le_natAbs (a := bridgeBoxColumn v)
    have hlo := Int.le_natAbs (a := -bridgeBoxColumn v)
    simp only [Int.natAbs_neg] at hlo
    constructor <;> omega
  have hlength := bridgeLength_le_columnInterval p
    (-(bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ)) (bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) hbox
  have hwidth : ((bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) + 1 - -(bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ)).toNat =
      2 * bridgeColumnRadius p + 1 := by omega
  simpa only [hwidth] using hlength
```

```lean
fiber convergence; the theorems below derive it from whole-family summability

noncomputable def fiberMass {α : Type*} (w : α → ℝ) (profile : α → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' a : {a : α // profile a = n}, w a.val

theorem summable_fiberMass_of_summable
    {α : Type*} {w : α → ℝ} (profile : α → ℕ) (hw : Summable w) :
    Summable (fiberMass w profile) := by
  exact (hw.hasSum.tsum_fiberwise profile).summable

  let f : (Σ n : ℕ, {a : α // profile a = n}) → ℝ :=
```

```lean
/-- At a fixed honeycomb vertex, a neighboring vertex is determined by its column.
This checks all three edges of the frozen adjacency relation. -/
theorem bridgeAdjacent_unique_of_column {u v w : Vertex}
    (huv : adjacent u v) (huw : adjacent u w)
    (hcolumn : bridgeBoxColumn v = bridgeBoxColumn w) : v = w := by
  cases u <;> cases v <;> cases w <;>
    simp only [adjacent, bridgeBoxColumn] at huv huw hcolumn
  all_goals
    rcases huv with ⟨hv1, hv2⟩ | ⟨hv1, hv2⟩ | ⟨hv1, hv2⟩
    all_goals
      rcases huw with ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ | ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ | ⟨hw1, hw2⟩
      all_goals congr 1 <;> omega

/-- With a common initial vertex, the complete column word determines a chain's tail. -/
theorem bridgeChain_tail_eq_of_columnWord {root : Vertex} {vs ws : List Vertex}
    (hvs : (root :: vs).IsChain adjacent)
    (hws : (root :: ws).IsChain adjacent)
    (hword : vs.map bridgeBoxColumn = ws.map bridgeBoxColumn) : vs = ws := by
  induction vs generalizing root ws with
  | nil =>
      cases ws with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons w ws => cases hword
  | cons v vs ih =>
      cases ws with
      | nil => cases hword
      | cons w ws =>
          have hwords : bridgeBoxColumn v = bridgeBoxColumn w ∧
              vs.map bridgeBoxColumn = ws.map bridgeBoxColumn := by
            simpa only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] using hword
          have hvw : v = w := bridgeAdjacent_unique_of_column
            (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hvs).1
            (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hws).1 hwords.1
          subst w
          exact congrArg (List.cons v) (ih
            (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hvs).2
            (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hws).2 hwords.2)

/-- Absolute integer columns of the canonical vertex list, including the source. -/
def bridgeColumnWord {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : List ℤ :=
  p.vertices.map bridgeBoxColumn

theorem bridgeVertices_eq_of_columnWord {h : ℕ} (p q : BridgePath h)
    (hword : bridgeColumnWord p = bridgeColumnWord q) :
    p.vertices = q.vertices := by
  have hpsource := p.source
  have hqsource := q.source
  have hpchain := p.connected
  have hqchain := q.connected
  unfold bridgeColumnWord at hword
  cases hp : p.vertices with
  | nil => simp only [hp, List.head?_nil, reduceCtorEq] at hpsource
  | cons v vs =>
      cases hq : q.vertices with
      | nil => simp only [hq, List.head?_nil, reduceCtorEq] at hqsource
      | cons w ws =>
          have hv : v = Vertex.up 0 0 := by
            simpa only [hp, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] using hpsource
          have hw : w = Vertex.up 0 0 := by
            simpa only [hq, List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] using hqsource
          subst v
          subst w
          apply congrArg (List.cons (Vertex.up 0 0))
          apply bridgeChain_tail_eq_of_columnWord
            (by simpa only [hp] using hpchain)
            (by simpa only [hq] using hqchain)
          exact (List.cons.inj (by simpa only [hp, hq, List.map_cons] using hword)).2

/-- Distinct canonical paths have distinct column words. No strip-count estimate is assumed. -/
theorem bridgeColumnWord_injective (h : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (bridgeColumnWord (h := h)) := by
  intro p q hword
  have hvertices := bridgeVertices_eq_of_columnWord p q hword
  cases p
  cases q
  cases hvertices
  rfl
```

    (hL : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → Summable (firstLengthWeight (h := h))) : FiniteBridgeSums := by
  intro h hh
  have hw : Summable (weight (h := h)) :=
    bridgeSummable_weight_of_summable_firstLengthWeight (hL h hh)
  have hc : Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p.val) :=
    (hL h hh).subtype (fun p : BridgePath h => InLogCorridor p)
  exact ⟨hw, hL h hh, (hL h hh).div_const (bridgeMass h),
    hw.subtype (fun p : BridgePath h => InLogCorridor p), hc,
    hc.div_const (confinedMass h)⟩

    ∀ {a b d : Vertex}, adjacent a b → adjacent a d →
      (match b with | .up i j => 2 * i + j | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) =
      (match d with | .up i j => 2 * i + j | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) →
      b = d := by
  intro a b d hab had hcode
  cases a with
  | up i j =>
      cases b with
      | up i' j' =>
          simp only [adjacent] at hab
      | down k l =>
          cases d with
          | up i' j' =>
              simp only [adjacent] at had
          | down k' l' =>

lemma bridgePath_tail_eq_of_column_map :
    ∀ (a : Vertex) {l₁ l₂ : List Vertex},
      List.IsChain adjacent (a :: l₁) →
      List.IsChain adjacent (a :: l₂) →
      (a :: l₁).map (fun v : Vertex => match v with
        | .up i j => 2 * i + j
        | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) =
      (a :: l₂).map (fun v : Vertex => match v with
        | .up i j => 2 * i + j
        | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) →
      l₁ = l₂ := by
  intro a l₁
  induction l₁ generalizing a with
  | nil =>
      intro l₂ _ _ hmap
      cases l₂ with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons d l₂ =>
          simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.cons.injEq, true_and] at hmap
          cases hmap
  | cons b l₁ ih =>
      intro l₂ hchain₁ hchain₂ hmap
      cases l₂ with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.cons.injEq, true_and] at hmap
          cases hmap
      | cons d l₂ =>
          simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq, true_and] at hmap
          obtain ⟨hhead, htail⟩ := hmap
          have hab : adjacent a b := (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hchain₁).1
          have had : adjacent a d := (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hchain₂).1
          have hbd : b = d := bridgeColumnStep_unique hab had hhead
          subst d
          have htail' : (b :: l₁).map (fun v : Vertex => match v with
                | .up i j => 2 * i + j
                | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) =
              (b :: l₂).map (fun v : Vertex => match v with
                | .up i j => 2 * i + j
                | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) := by
            simp only [List.map_cons, htail]
          exact congrArg (fun l => b :: l)
            (ih b (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hchain₁).2
              (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hchain₂).2 htail')

lemma bridgePath_eq_of_column_eq {h : ℕ} {p q : BridgePath h} :
    p.vertices.map (fun v : Vertex => match v with
      | .up i j => 2 * i + j
      | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) =
    q.vertices.map (fun v : Vertex => match v with
      | .up i j => 2 * i + j
      | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) →
    p = q := by
  intro hmap
  obtain ⟨l₁, hp⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp p.source
  obtain ⟨l₂, hq⟩ := List.head?_eq_some_iff.mp q.source
  have hchain₁ : List.IsChain adjacent (Vertex.up 0 0 :: l₁) := by
    rw [← hp]
    exact p.connected
  have hchain₂ : List.IsChain adjacent (Vertex.up 0 0 :: l₂) := by
    rw [← hq]
    exact q.connected
  have hmap' : (Vertex.up 0 0 :: l₁).map (fun v : Vertex => match v with
        | .up i j => 2 * i + j
        | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) =
      (Vertex.up 0 0 :: l₂).map (fun v : Vertex => match v with
        | .up i j => 2 * i + j
        | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1) := by
    rw [← hp, ← hq]
    exact hmap
  have hl : l₁ = l₂ := bridgePath_tail_eq_of_column_map (Vertex.up 0 0)
    hchain₁ hchain₂ hmap'
  have hv : p.vertices = q.vertices := by
    rw [hp, hq, hl]
  cases p with
  | mk pv pd pc ps pt pi =>
      cases q with
      | mk qv qd qc qs qt qi =>
          simp only at hv
          subst qv
          simp

task.objective: Prove that the full column coordinate word determines a BridgePath with the fixed source, eliminating horizontal-realization multiplicity from a future exact transfer encoding.   | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

    Function.Injective bridgeLayerColumnCode := by
  intro v w h
  cases v <;> cases w <;>

  · congr 1 <;> omega

theorem bridgeBoxColumn_eq_twice_position (v : Vertex) :
    (bridgeBoxColumn v : ℝ) = 2 * (position v).1 := by
  cases v <;> simp only [bridgeBoxColumn, position] <;> push_cast <;> ring
changes.name: bridgeBoxColumn_eq_twice_position

theorem bridgeBoundedVertices_finite (h : ℕ) (B : ℝ) :
    Set.Finite {v : Vertex |
      0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ) ∧ |(position v).1| ≤ B} := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * B)
  have hfinite : Set.Finite
      ((Set.Ico (0 : ℤ) (h : ℤ)) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)) :=
    (Set.finite_Ico _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _)
  apply (Set.Finite.preimage bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective.injOn hfinite).subset
  intro v hv
  have hcol : |(bridgeBoxColumn v : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * B := by
    rw [bridgeBoxColumn_eq_twice_position, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv.2.2 (by norm_num)
  have hcol' := abs_le.mp hcol
  have hlow : -(N : ℝ) ≤ (bridgeBoxColumn v : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hhigh : (bridgeBoxColumn v : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by linarith
  exact ⟨⟨hv.1, hv.2.1⟩, by exact_mod_cast hlow, by exact_mod_cast hhigh⟩
changes.name: bridgeBoundedVertices_finite

/-- Integer column coordinate of the frozen honeycomb vertices. -/
def bridgeBoxColumn : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- The frozen layer and integer column identify a honeycomb vertex uniquely. -/
noncomputable def bridgeLayerColumnCode (v : Vertex) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (layer v, bridgeBoxColumn v)

theorem bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective :
    Function.Injective bridgeLayerColumnCode := by
  intro v w h
  cases v <;> cases w <;>
    simp only [bridgeLayerColumnCode, layer, bridgeBoxColumn, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  · congr 1 <;> omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · congr 1 <;> omega


===== END ExistingColumnCode.lean.inc =====

===== BEGIN ConfinedFiniteness.lean.inc (exact verified new proof fragment) =====
/-- The integer column is twice the canonical horizontal coordinate. -/
theorem bridgeBoxColumn_eq_twice_position (v : Vertex) :
    (bridgeBoxColumn v : ℝ) = 2 * (position v).1 := by
  cases v <;> simp only [bridgeBoxColumn, position, Prod.fst] <;> push_cast <;> ring

/-- Layer confinement and a fixed horizontal bound leave only finitely many vertices. -/
theorem bridgeBoundedVertices_finite (h : ℕ) (B : ℝ) :
    Set.Finite {v : Vertex |
      0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ) ∧ |(position v).1| ≤ B} := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * B)
  have hfinite : Set.Finite
      ((Set.Ico (0 : ℤ) (h : ℤ)) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)) :=
    (Set.finite_Ico _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _)
  apply (Set.Finite.preimage bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective.injOn hfinite).subset
  intro v hv
  have hcol : |(bridgeBoxColumn v : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * B := by
    rw [bridgeBoxColumn_eq_twice_position, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv.2.2 (by norm_num)
  have hcol' := abs_le.mp hcol
  have hlow : -(N : ℝ) ≤ (bridgeBoxColumn v : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hhigh : (bridgeBoxColumn v : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by linarith
  exact ⟨⟨hv.1, hv.2.1⟩, by exact_mod_cast hlow, by exact_mod_cast hhigh⟩

/-- The actual allowed vertex type for the canonical logarithmic corridor. -/
def ConfinedBridgeVertex (h : ℕ) :=
  {v : Vertex | 0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ) ∧
    |(position v).1| ≤ (h : ℝ) * (Real.log (h : ℝ)) ^ 2}

theorem bridgeConfinedVertex_finite (h : ℕ) : Finite (ConfinedBridgeVertex h) :=
  (bridgeBoundedVertices_finite h ((h : ℝ) * (Real.log (h : ℝ)) ^ 2)).to_subtype

/-- Keep the canonical vertex order, with its already-proved confinement attached. -/
noncomputable def bridgeConfinedVertexList {h : ℕ} (p : ConfinedBridgePath h) :
    List (ConfinedBridgeVertex h) :=
  p.val.vertices.attachWith _ (fun v hv =>
    ⟨(p.val.inStrip v hv).1, (p.val.inStrip v hv).2, p.property v hv⟩)

theorem bridgeConfinedVertexList_map_val {h : ℕ} (p : ConfinedBridgePath h) :
    (bridgeConfinedVertexList p).map Subtype.val = p.val.vertices :=
  List.attachWith_map_subtype_val _

theorem bridgeConfinedVertexList_nodup {h : ℕ} (p : ConfinedBridgePath h) :
    (bridgeConfinedVertexList p).Nodup := by
  apply List.Nodup.of_map Subtype.val
  rw [bridgeConfinedVertexList_map_val]
  exact p.val.distinct

/-- A canonical confined path is determined by its ordered confined vertex list. -/
theorem bridgeConfinedVertexList_injective (h : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (bridgeConfinedVertexList (h := h)) := by
  intro p q heq
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hvertices : p.val.vertices = q.val.vertices := by
    simpa only [bridgeConfinedVertexList_map_val] using
      congrArg (List.map Subtype.val) heq
  cases p with
  | mk p hp =>
    cases q with
    | mk q hq =>
      cases p
      cases q
      cases hvertices
      rfl

/-- For each height, there are finitely many canonical logarithmically confined bridges.
The proof uses only the fixed geometry, strip bounds, confinement and no repeated vertices. -/
theorem bridgeConfinedPath_finite (h : ℕ) : Finite (ConfinedBridgePath h) := by
  classical
  letI := bridgeConfinedVertex_finite h
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (ConfinedBridgeVertex h)
  let encode : ConfinedBridgePath h →
      {vs : List (ConfinedBridgeVertex h) // vs.Nodup} :=
    fun p => ⟨bridgeConfinedVertexList p, bridgeConfinedVertexList_nodup p⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective encode (fun _ _ heq =>
    bridgeConfinedVertexList_injective h (congrArg Subtype.val heq))

/-- The confined weight sum is finite without any full-strip growth hypothesis. -/
theorem bridgeConfined_summable_weight (h : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => weight p.val) := by
  letI := bridgeConfinedPath_finite h
  exact summable_of_finite_support (Set.toFinite _)

/-- The confined first-length weight sum is finite without any growth hypothesis. -/
theorem bridgeConfined_summable_firstLengthWeight (h : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p.val) := by
  letI := bridgeConfinedPath_finite h
  exact summable_of_finite_support (Set.toFinite _)

/-- Division by the canonical confined mass also leaves a summable finite family.
No positivity assumption is needed, including at heights whose confined family is empty. -/
theorem bridgeConfined_summable_normalizedFirstLengthWeight (h : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p.val / confinedMass h) := by
