```lean
    (∃ i, v = .up i 1) ∨ (∃ i, v = .down i 1) := by
  cases v with
  | up i j =>
    have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by simp only [inside, layer] at h; omega
    rcases hj with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩))
  | down i j =>
    have hj : j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by simp only [inside, layer] at h; omega
    rcases hj with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩))

lemma mem_neighbors {a b : Vertex} (ha : inside a) :
    b ∈ neighbors a ↔ adjacent a b ∧ inside b := by
  rcases inside_cases ha with ⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩ <;>
  cases b <;> simp [neighbors, adjacent, inside, layer, Vertex.up.injEq, Vertex.down.injEq] <;> omega

noncomputable def nextPairs (a b : Vertex) : Finset (Vertex × Vertex) := by
  classical
  exact ((neighbors b).erase a).biUnion fun c =>
    ((neighbors c).erase b).image fun d => (c,d)

lemma nextPairs_card {a b : Vertex} (ha : inside a) (hb : inside b)
    (hab : adjacent a b) : (nextPairs a b).card ≤ 3 := by
  classical
  have ha_mem : a ∈ neighbors b := (mem_neighbors hb).2 ⟨by
    cases a <;> cases b <;> exact hab, ha⟩
  rcases inside_cases hb with ⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩
  all_goals
    simp [neighbors] at ha_mem
    rcases ha_mem with rfl | rfl | rfl
    all_goals
      have hi : i - 1 ≠ i := by omega
      have hj : i ≠ i - 1 := by omega
      simp [nextPairs, neighbors, Finset.erase_insert_of_ne, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem,
        Vertex.up.injEq, Vertex.down.injEq, hi, hj]
      all_goals first
        | exact Finset.card_le_three
        | exact Finset.card_le_two.trans (by omega)
        | exact lt_of_le_of_lt Finset.card_le_two (by omega)

lemma neighbors_card {b : Vertex} (hb : inside b) : (neighbors b).card ≤ 3 := by
  rcases inside_cases hb with ⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩ <;>
    simp [neighbors, Vertex.up.injEq, Vertex.down.injEq]
  all_goals first
    | exact Finset.card_le_three
    | exact Finset.card_le_two.trans (by omega)

lemma erase_neighbors_card {a b : Vertex} (ha : inside a) (hb : inside b)
    (hab : adjacent a b) : ((neighbors b).erase a).card ≤ 2 := by
  have ha_mem : a ∈ neighbors b := (mem_neighbors hb).2 ⟨by
    cases a <;> cases b <;> exact hab, ha⟩
  have h := Finset.card_erase_add_one ha_mem
  have hc := neighbors_card hb
  omega

lemma nextPairs_valid {a b : Vertex} {cd : Vertex × Vertex}
    (hb : inside b) (hcd : cd ∈ nextPairs a b) :
    inside cd.1 ∧ inside cd.2 ∧ adjacent cd.1 cd.2 := by
  classical
  rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hcd with ⟨c,hc,hd⟩
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hd with ⟨d,hdmem,rfl⟩
  have hcin : inside c := ((mem_neighbors hb).1 (Finset.mem_erase.mp hc).2).2
  have hdin := (mem_neighbors hcin).1 (Finset.mem_erase.mp hdmem).2
  exact ⟨hcin,hdin.2,hdin.1⟩

noncomputable def continuations (a b : Vertex) : ℕ → Finset (List Vertex)
  | 0 => {[]}
  | 1 => ((neighbors b).erase a).image fun c => [c]
  | n + 2 => (nextPairs a b).biUnion fun cd =>
      (continuations cd.1 cd.2 n).image fun l => cd.1 :: cd.2 :: l

lemma continuations_card (n : ℕ) (a b : Vertex)
    (ha : inside a) (hb : inside b) (hab : adjacent a b) :
    (continuations a b n).card ≤ 2 * 3 ^ (n / 2) := by
  classical
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction generalizing a b with
  | zero => simp [continuations]
  | one =>
    simpa [continuations] using
      (Finset.card_image_le.trans (erase_neighbors_card ha hb hab))
  | more n ih _ =>
    calc (continuations a b (n+2)).card
        ≤ ∑ cd ∈ nextPairs a b,
            ((continuations cd.1 cd.2 n).image fun l => cd.1 :: cd.2 :: l).card :=
          Finset.card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ _cd ∈ nextPairs a b, 2 * 3 ^ (n/2) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro cd hcd
          obtain ⟨hc,hd,hcda⟩ := nextPairs_valid hb hcd
          exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (ih cd.1 cd.2 hc hd hcda)
      _ = (nextPairs a b).card * (2 * 3 ^ (n/2)) := by simp
      _ ≤ 3 * (2 * 3 ^ (n/2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (nextPairs_card ha hb hab)
      _ = 2 * 3 ^ ((n+2)/2) := by
          rw [show (n+2)/2 = n/2+1 by omega, pow_succ]
          ring

lemma mem_continuations {a b : Vertex} {l : List Vertex}
    (hc : (a :: b :: l).IsChain adjacent)
    (hnd : (a :: b :: l).Nodup)
    (hin : ∀ v ∈ a :: b :: l, inside v) :
    l ∈ continuations a b l.length := by
  classical
  induction l using List.twoStepInduction generalizing a b with
  | nil => simp [continuations]
  | singleton c =>
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨c,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_,?_⟩,rfl⟩
    · have hnot := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
      simpa using (fun h : c = a => hnot (by simp [h]))
    · exact (mem_neighbors (hin b (by simp))).2 ⟨hc.tail.rel,hin c (by simp)⟩
  | cons_cons c d l ih _ =>
    have hcin : inside c := hin c (by simp)
    have hdin : inside d := hin d (by simp)
    have hcn : c ≠ a := by
      intro h
      exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1 (by simp [h])
    have hdn : d ≠ b := by
      intro h
      exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd.tail).1 (by simp [h])
    have hpair : (c,d) ∈ nextPairs a b := by
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨c,Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hcn,?_⟩,?_⟩
      · exact (mem_neighbors (hin b (by simp))).2 ⟨hc.tail.rel,hcin⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨d,Finset.mem_erase.mpr
          ⟨hdn,(mem_neighbors hcin).2 ⟨hc.tail.tail.rel,hdin⟩⟩,rfl⟩
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨(c,d),hpair,Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨l,?_,rfl⟩⟩
    apply ih hc.tail.tail hnd.tail.tail
    intro v hv
    exact hin v (by simp only [List.mem_cons] at hv ⊢; tauto)

noncomputable def allPaths (n : ℕ) : Finset (List Vertex) :=
  (neighbors (.up 0 0)).biUnion fun b =>
    (continuations (.up 0 0) b (n-2)).image fun l => (.up 0 0) :: b :: l

lemma allPaths_card (n : ℕ) : (allPaths n).card ≤ 4 * 3 ^ (n/2) := by
  classical
  have hs : inside (.up 0 0) := by simp [inside,layer]
  calc (allPaths n).card
      ≤ ∑ b ∈ neighbors (.up 0 0),
          ((continuations (.up 0 0) b (n-2)).image fun l => (.up 0 0) :: b :: l).card :=
        Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _b ∈ neighbors (.up 0 0), 2 * 3 ^ ((n-2)/2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro b hb
        obtain ⟨hadj,hbin⟩ := (mem_neighbors hs).1 hb
        exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (continuations_card (n-2) _ _ hs hbin hadj)
    _ = 4 * 3 ^ ((n-2)/2) := by simp [neighbors]; ring
    _ ≤ 4 * 3 ^ (n/2) := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
        exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)

lemma path_mem_allPaths (p : BridgePath 2) : p.vertices ∈ allPaths p.vertices.length := by
  classical
  have hsrc := p.source
  have hterm := p.terminal
  cases hv : p.vertices with
  | nil => simp [hv] at hsrc
  | cons a l =>
    have ha : a = .up 0 0 := by simpa [hv] using hsrc
    subst a
    cases l with
    | nil =>
      rcases hterm with ⟨i,hi⟩
      simp [hv] at hi
    | cons b l =>
      have hc : ((.up 0 0) :: b :: l).IsChain adjacent := by simpa only [hv] using p.connected
      have hnd : ((.up 0 0) :: b :: l).Nodup := by simpa only [hv] using p.distinct
      have hin : ∀ v ∈ (.up 0 0) :: b :: l, inside v := by
        intro v h
        have hvp : v ∈ p.vertices := by simpa only [hv] using h
        simpa only [inside, Nat.cast_ofNat] using p.inStrip v hvp
      rw [allPaths]
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨b,(mem_neighbors (hin _ (by simp))).2 ⟨hc.rel,hin b (by simp)⟩,?_⟩
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨l,?_,by simpa only [hv]⟩
      have hlen : l.length + 1 + 1 - 2 = l.length := by omega
      simpa only [hv,List.length_cons,hlen] using mem_continuations hc hnd hin

lemma path_card (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath 2))
    (hlen : ∀ p ∈ s, p.vertices.length = n) : s.card ≤ 4 * 3 ^ (n/2) := by
  classical
  have hm : Set.MapsTo (fun p : BridgePath 2 => p.vertices) (s : Set (BridgePath 2))
      (allPaths n : Set (List Vertex)) := by
    intro p hp
    change p.vertices ∈ allPaths n
    simpa only [hlen p hp] using path_mem_allPaths p
  have hi : Set.InjOn (fun p : BridgePath 2 => p.vertices) (s : Set (BridgePath 2)) := by
    intro p hp q hq he
    cases p
    cases q
    cases he
    rfl
  exact (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ hm hi).trans (allPaths_card n)

lemma sqrt_three_lt_mu : Real.sqrt 3 < 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) := by
  have hsq2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = (2 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have h2 : (1 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := by nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hroot : Real.sqrt 3 < Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  rw [Real.cos_pi_div_eight]
  nlinarith

lemma path_card_real (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath 2))
    (hlen : ∀ p ∈ s, p.vertices.length = n) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 3 ^ n := by
  have hcard : (s.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (n/2) := by
    exact_mod_cast path_card n s hlen
  have hge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 3 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 3]
  calc (s.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (3 : ℝ) ^ (n/2) := hcard
    _ = 4 * Real.sqrt 3 ^ (2*(n/2)) := by
        rw [pow_mul,Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
    _ ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 3 ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_right₀ hge (by omega)) (by norm_num)

theorem stripGrowthAtTwo :
    ∃ C β : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ β < 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath 2)),
        (∀ p ∈ s, p.vertices.length = n) → (s.card : ℝ) ≤ C * β ^ n := by
  exact ⟨4, Real.sqrt 3, by norm_num, Real.sqrt_nonneg 3,
    sqrt_three_lt_mu, path_card_real⟩

end WidthTwo

/-- Unconditional fixed-width-two diagnostic. This does not prove all widths. -/
theorem width_two_summability_diagnostic :
    Summable (weight (h := 2)) ∧ Summable (firstLengthWeight (h := 2)) := by
  obtain ⟨C, β, hC, hβ, hlt, hcount⟩ := WidthTwo.stripGrowthAtTwo
  have hL : Summable (firstLengthWeight (h := 2)) :=
    bridgeSummable_firstLengthWeight_of_mu_bound hC hβ hlt hcount
  exact ⟨bridgeSummable_weight_of_summable_firstLengthWeight hL,hL⟩
```

```lean
open scoped BigOperators

/-- Integer column coordinate of the frozen honeycomb vertices. -/
def bridgeBoxColumn : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- A path lies in the two-column-slab box indexed by `-R, ..., R`. -/
def bridgeInColumnBox {h : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
    -(2 * (R : ℤ)) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
      bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ 2 * (R : ℤ) + 1

/-- Every finite family of finite bridge paths lies in one common column box. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox {h : ℕ} (s : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p := by
  classical
  let radius : BridgePath h → ℕ := fun p =>
    p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
  let R : ℕ := s.sup radius
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro p hp v hv
  have hpR : radius p ≤ R := Finset.le_sup hp
  have hvR : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ radius p :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun v : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
      (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)
  have hnat : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ R := hvR.trans hpR
  have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have habs : |bridgeBoxColumn v| ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using hcast
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
  constructor <;> omega

/-- A bound uniform in the box radius bounds every finite bridge-family sum. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    ∀ s : Finset (BridgePath h), ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K := by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox s
  exact H R s hR

/-- Conditional zeroth-mass reduction. The uniform finite-box bound is an input;
this theorem does not establish that bound or any first length moment. -/
theorem bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    Summable (weight (h := h)) := by
  exact summable_of_sum_le (fun p => bridgeWeight_nonneg p)
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)

/-- The same still-unproved finite-box input also bounds the full bridge mass. -/
theorem bridgeMass_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    bridgeMass h ≤ K := by
  exact (bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H).tsum_le_of_sum_le
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)
```

```lean
namespace TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

/-- A finite nonnegative factorization of `c (a+b)` is enough to upgrade its
zeroth moment to its first moment. States whose left or right sequence vanishes
contribute zero, so no reachability or trimming premise is required. -/
theorem summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {c : ℕ → ℝ} {L R : ℕ → ι → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ L n i) (hR : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ R n i)
    (hfactor : ∀ a b, c (a + b) = ∑ i, L a i * R b i)
    (hc : Summable c) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * c n) := by
  classical
  have hterm (a b : ℕ) (i : ι) : L a i * R b i ≤ c (a + b) := by
    rw [hfactor a b]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hL a j) (hR b j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hprod (i : ι) : Summable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => L p.1 i * R p.2 i) := by
    by_cases hzeroL : ∀ a, L a i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroL, zero_mul] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    by_cases hzeroR : ∀ b, R b i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroR, mul_zero] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    push Not at hzeroL hzeroR
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hzeroL
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hzeroR
    have hleftScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i * R b i) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL n i) (hR b i))
        (fun n => hterm n b i) ((summable_nat_add_iff b).2 hc)
    have hrightScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L a i * R n i) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL a i) (hR n i)) (fun n => hterm a n i) ?_
      simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using ((summable_nat_add_iff a).2 hc)
    have hleft : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i) :=
      (summable_mul_right_iff hb).1 hleftScaled
    have hright : Summable (fun n : ℕ => R n i) :=
      (summable_mul_left_iff ha).1 hrightScaled
    exact hleft.mul_of_nonneg hright (fun n => hL n i) (fun n => hR n i)
  have hconv (i : ι) :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul
      (f := fun n : ℕ => L n i) (g := fun n : ℕ => R n i) (hprod i)
  have hsum : Summable
      (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum (fun i _ => hconv i)
  have hweighted : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n) := by
    refine hsum.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, ∑ i, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) =
          ∑ _p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, c n := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        rw [← hfactor p.1 p.2, Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp]
      _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.Nat.card_antidiagonal, nsmul_eq_mul]
  refine (hweighted.sub hc).congr fun n => ?_
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  ring

/-- The scalar Green coefficients of a finite nonnegative transfer matrix. -/
def matrixMass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ n) *ᵥ v)

/-- For a finite entrywise nonnegative matrix and nonnegative endpoint vectors,
summability of the single scalar Green series implies its first-moment
summability, even when invisible states have divergent matrix Green series. -/
theorem summable_matrix_firstMoment
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i)
    (hc : Summable (matrixMass A u v)) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * matrixMass A u v n) := by
  apply summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    (L := fun n => u ᵥ* (A ^ n)) (R := fun n => (A ^ n) *ᵥ v)
    (hc := hc)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (hu j) (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n j i)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n i j) (hv j)
  · intro a b
    change u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ (a + b)) *ᵥ v) =
      (u ᵥ* (A ^ a)) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ b) *ᵥ v)
    rw [pow_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]


end TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment
```

```lean
/-- The frozen layer and integer column identify a honeycomb vertex uniquely. -/
noncomputable def bridgeLayerColumnCode (v : Vertex) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (layer v, bridgeBoxColumn v)

theorem bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective :
    Function.Injective bridgeLayerColumnCode := by
  intro v w h
  cases v <;> cases w <;>
    simp only [bridgeLayerColumnCode, layer, bridgeBoxColumn, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  · congr 1 <;> omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · congr 1 <;> omega

/-- A nodup strip list has at most one vertex for each allowed layer-column pair.
No connectivity, source, terminal, or unproved counting estimate is used. -/
theorem bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet
    {h : ℕ} (vs : List Vertex) (hnodup : vs.Nodup)
    (hstrip : ∀ v ∈ vs, 0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ))
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ vs, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    vs.length ≤ h * columns.card := by
  classical
  let image := vs.toFinset.image bridgeLayerColumnCode
  let box := (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (h : ℤ)) ×ˢ columns
  have hsub : image ⊆ box := by
    intro pair hpair
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpair
    have hvlist : v ∈ vs := List.mem_toFinset.mp hv
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_Ico.mpr (hstrip v hvlist), hcolumns v hvlist⟩
  have hcard : image.card = vs.length := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective]
    exact List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
  have hboxcard : box.card = h * columns.card := by
    simp only [box, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico, sub_zero, Int.toNat_natCast]
  calc
    vs.length = image.card := hcard.symm
    _ ≤ box.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = h * columns.card := hboxcard

theorem bridgeLength_le_columnSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card :=
  bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet p.vertices p.distinct p.inStrip columns hcolumns

/-- The interval may even be empty; its natural cardinality handles that case. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnInterval {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (a b : ℤ)
    (hbox : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, a ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧ bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ b) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (b + 1 - a).toNat := by
  have h := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p (Finset.Icc a b)
    (fun v hv => Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (hbox v hv))
  simpa only [Int.card_Icc] using h

/-- Exact geometric size bound for the already defined symmetric slab box. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnBox {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (R : ℕ)

  have hlength := bridgeLength_le_columnInterval p
    (-(2 * (R : ℤ))) (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1) hbox
  have hwidth : (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1 + 1 - -(2 * (R : ℤ))).toNat = 4 * R + 2 := by
    omega
  simpa only [hwidth] using hlength

/-- Index of the two-column slab containing a vertex, using integer floor division. -/
def bridgeBoxSlab (v : Vertex) : ℤ := bridgeBoxColumn v / 2

/-- A finite set of two-column slabs contains at most `2*h` vertices per slab. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_slabSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (slabs : Finset ℤ)
    (hslabs : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxSlab v ∈ slabs) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ 2 * h * slabs.card := by
  classical
  let slots := slabs ×ˢ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) 2
  let columns := slots.image (fun q : ℤ × ℤ => 2 * q.1 + q.2)
  have hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns := by
    intro v hv
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨(bridgeBoxColumn v / 2, bridgeBoxColumn v % 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨hslabs v hv, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
    · omega
  have hcard : columns.card ≤ slabs.card * 2 := by
    calc
      columns.card ≤ slots.card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = slabs.card * 2 := by
        simp only [slots, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico]
        rfl
  calc
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p columns hcolumns
    _ ≤ h * (slabs.card * 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left h hcard
    _ = 2 * h * slabs.card := by ac_rfl

  intro v hv
```

```lean
namespace TheoremOS.ProfileSummability

open scoped BigOperators

/-- The real mass of an exact profile fiber. Its use as a coefficient requires
fiber convergence; the theorems below derive it from whole-family summability
or request `HasSum`, rather than relying on a possibly divergent `tsum`. -/
noncomputable def fiberMass {α : Type*} (w : α → ℝ) (profile : α → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' a : {a : α // profile a = n}, w a.val

theorem summable_fiberMass_of_summable
    {α : Type*} {w : α → ℝ} (profile : α → ℕ) (hw : Summable w) :
    Summable (fiberMass w profile) := by
  exact (hw.hasSum.tsum_fiberwise profile).summable


/-- Exact convergent fiber sums may be lifted through any nonnegative profile
multiplier. Fibers may be infinite; each is required to have the stated sum. -/
theorem summable_profileScale_of_hasSum
    {α : Type*} {w : α → ℝ} {profile : α → ℕ} {c scale : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a) (hscale : ∀ n, 0 ≤ scale n)
    (hfiber : ∀ n, HasSum (fun a : {a : α // profile a = n} => w a.val) (c n))
    (hc : Summable (fun n => scale n * c n)) :
    Summable (fun a => scale (profile a) * w a) := by
  let f : (Σ n : ℕ, {a : α // profile a = n}) → ℝ :=
    fun p => scale p.1 * w p.2.val
  have hscaled (n : ℕ) :
      HasSum (fun a : {a : α // profile a = n} => scale n * w a.val)
        (scale n * c n) := (hfiber n).mul_left (scale n)
  have hsigma : Summable f :=
    (summable_sigma_of_nonneg (f := f)
      (fun p => mul_nonneg (hscale p.1) (hw p.2.val))).2
      ⟨fun n => (hscaled n).summable,
        hc.congr (fun n => (hscaled n).tsum_eq.symm)⟩
  have hreindex : Summable
      (fun p : Σ n : ℕ, {a : α // profile a = n} =>
        scale (profile p.2.val) * w p.2.val) := by
    refine hsigma.congr fun p => ?_
    change scale p.1 * w p.2.val = scale (profile p.2.val) * w p.2.val
    rw [p.2.property]
  exact (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv profile).summable_iff.mp hreindex


/-- A first moment in an arbitrary natural profile dominates a size moment
whenever `size <= C * (profile+1)`. The shift handles zero/offset profiles. -/
theorem summable_sizeWeight_of_hasSum
    {α : Type*} {w : α → ℝ} {size profile : α → ℕ} {c : ℕ → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsize : ∀ a, (size a : ℝ) ≤ C * ((profile a : ℝ) + 1))
    (hfiber : ∀ n, HasSum (fun a : {a : α // profile a = n} => w a.val) (c n))
    (hc : Summable c) (hmoment : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * c n)) :
    Summable (fun a => (size a : ℝ) * w a) := by
  have hshift : Summable (fun n : ℕ => C * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * c n) := by
    refine ((hmoment.add hc).mul_left C).congr fun n => ?_
    ring
  have hscale : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ C * ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=
    fun n => mul_nonneg hC (add_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) zero_le_one)
  have hdom : Summable (fun a => C * ((profile a : ℝ) + 1) * w a) :=
    summable_profileScale_of_hasSum (w := w) (profile := profile) (c := c)
      (scale := fun n => C * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) hw hscale hfiber hshift
  exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun a => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hw a))
    (fun a => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsize a) (hw a)) hdom


end TheoremOS.ProfileSummability
```

```lean
theorem bridgeAdjacent_unique_of_column {u v w : Vertex}
    (huv : adjacent u v) (huw : adjacent u w)
    (hcolumn : bridgeBoxColumn v = bridgeBoxColumn w) : v = w := by
  cases u <;> cases v <;> cases w <;>
    simp only [adjacent, bridgeBoxColumn] at huv huw hcolumn
  all_goals
    rcases huv with ⟨hv1, hv2⟩ | ⟨hv1, hv2⟩ | ⟨hv1, hv2⟩
    all_goals
      rcases huw with ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ | ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ | ⟨hw1, hw2⟩

    (hws : (root :: ws).IsChain adjacent)
    (hword : vs.map bridgeBoxColumn = ws.map bridgeBoxColumn) : vs = ws := by

  p.vertices.map bridgeBoxColumn

theorem bridgeVertices_eq_of_columnWord {h : ℕ} (p q : BridgePath h)
    (hword : bridgeColumnWord p = bridgeColumnWord q) :

  have hpsource := p.source
  have hqsource := q.source
```

contract.formalStatement:
import Mathlib

namespace OAI

namespace PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor

inductive Vertex where
  | up (i j : ℤ)
  | down (i j : ℤ)
  deriving DecidableEq

noncomputable def position : Vertex → ℝ × ℝ
  | .up i j => ((i : ℝ) + (j : ℝ) / 2,
      ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 3) * (Real.sqrt 3 / 2))
  | .down i j => ((i : ℝ) + (j : ℝ) / 2 + 1 / 2,
      ((j : ℝ) + 2 / 3) * (Real.sqrt 3 / 2))

def adjacent : Vertex → Vertex → Prop
  | .up i j, .down k l =>
      (k = i ∧ l = j - 1) ∨ (k = i ∧ l = j) ∨ (k = i - 1 ∧ l = j)
  | .down k l, .up i j =>
      (k = i ∧ l = j - 1) ∨ (k = i ∧ l = j) ∨ (k = i - 1 ∧ l = j)
  | _, _ => False

noncomputable def criticalActivity : ℝ := (2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 8))⁻¹
noncomputable def layer (vertex : Vertex) : ℤ :=
  Vertex.rec (fun _ vertical => vertical) (fun _ vertical => vertical) vertex

structure BridgePath (h : ℕ) where
  vertices : List Vertex
  distinct : vertices.Nodup
  connected : vertices.IsChain adjacent
  source : vertices.head? = some (.up 0 0)
  terminal : ∃ i : ℤ, vertices.getLast? = some (.down i ((h : ℤ) - 1))
  inStrip : ∀ v ∈ vertices, 0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ)

noncomputable def weight {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : ℝ :=
  criticalActivity ^ p.vertices.length

noncomputable def firstLengthWeight {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : ℝ :=
  (p.vertices.length : ℝ) * weight p

noncomputable def bridgeMass (h : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑' p : BridgePath h, weight p
noncomputable def InLogCorridor {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, |(position v).1| ≤ (h : ℝ) * (Real.log (h : ℝ)) ^ 2

def ConfinedBridgePath (h : ℕ) := {p : BridgePath h // InLogCorridor p}

noncomputable def confinedMass (h : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' p : ConfinedBridgePath h, weight p.val
def FiniteBridgeSums : Prop :=
  ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h →
    Summable (weight (h := h)) ∧ Summable (firstLengthWeight (h := h)) ∧
    Summable (fun p : BridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p / bridgeMass h) ∧
    Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => weight p.val) ∧
    Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p.val) ∧
    Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p.val / confinedMass h)


theorem finite_bridge_sums : FiniteBridgeSums := by
  sorry

end PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor

end OAI
